name: workwood
description: Run and oversee several Claude Code sessions at once, grouped by Claudius profile.

scripts.postinstall: node shell/need-node.cjs && install-electron && node -e "for (const a of ['arm64','x64']) { try { require('fs').chmodSync('node_modules/node-pty/prebuilds/darwin-'+a+'/spawn-helper', 0o755) } catch {} }"
scripts.test: node shell/need-node.cjs && node --test tests/app.test.mjs tests/phone.test.mjs tests/copy.test.mjs
